observations: What I read and in what order: docs/REVISION-AND-REVIEWS.md, docs/PROMPTS.md, then this request JSON in full. Then I used Read to view storyboards-unnumbered/page-06.png and storyboards/page-06.png, then review/page-05.png and review/page-06.png, assets/panels/06-1.png and 06-2.png, source/original.txt and source/REVISION-2026-11-11.md. All files were readable. The runtime gave me no task ID, so task is null.

PNG against SVG: I compared the label and balloon rects in storyboards-unnumbered/page-06.svg and storyboards/page-06.svg with both PNGs. The rects are title 138,106 639x74; tiles 193/421/624 at y 388; PLAN OF CARE 40,1108 287x234. The balloon is at about 304-745 x 684-822 with its tail to the ananya box. Both PNGs show these positions. The numbered PNG adds only the grey guide captions '1 / Close-up...' and '2 / Next steps together; the plan of care'.
Text against source lines 43-44: verbatim. The title, the three tile labels, Ananya's line and the PLAN OF CARE label all match. They also match the workflow.json panels 06-1 and 06-2.

First reader, uneven spacing of the tile labels (wide Dentist/Eye gap, Eye/Paediatrician almost touching): in the art, each label sits on the blank bar at the foot of its own drawn tile. The spacing therefore follows the three screen tiles, not a free layout. The Paediatrician box is taller (three lines) and comes within about 6 px of the Eye box. The left-to-right order still cannot be misread. Acceptable.
First reader, large blank area between the title and the tiles: in 06-1 that area holds the tooth chart, the eye diagram and the growth chart with the vaccine card. This is a placeholder effect only.

First reader, who uses the planner and how it links to the previous scene: 06-1 shows the same laptop with Ananya's hand on the trackpad, her white sleeve and teal cuff at the right, and the consultation-room window and plant. Read after 05-4, where she listens beside the open laptop, it is her screen in the same visit. Resolved by the art.
First reader, Ravi gives no spoken reply to 'together': in 06-2 Ravi smiles, relaxed, with both hands on his knees. That is a visible agreement, and the source gives him no line here. Acceptable.

First reader, PLAN OF CARE at the far left might be read before the balloon: the label's top is at y 1108, about 290 px below the balloon's bottom (822), so a top-down reading takes the balloon first. In the art the label covers the laptop screen at lower left, so it reads as the screen's section name, as the source intends ('Label (on the screen)'). Acceptable.

Unnumbered ネーム: title label, then Dentist, Eye doctor and Paediatrician left to right, then Ananya's balloon at the top of 06-2, then the PLAN OF CARE label at lower left. This matches the script order.
The only balloon's tail ends at the ananya box. The ravi box is silent. No text touches a placeholder face box.

transitions.observation: From Ananya listening beside the open laptop with its glowing mic to a close-up of the same laptop, now on the planner section. Her hand on the trackpad, the window and the plant keep it in the same consultation.

From the planner close-up out to the two-shot past the laptop, now on the plan of care. Ananya says the shared next-steps line and Ravi nods, relaxed. The screen change shows progress through the doctor's sections.

After the page turn the scene is back at reception: Meera behind the desk, the waiting chairs, and Ravi with his bag on his shoulder and his phone out. The visit has visibly moved on from the consultation.

readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order matches mine and the script. Of their concerns, the label spacing follows the drawn tiles. The blank area and the link to the previous scene are resolved by the 06-1 art (laptop, Ananya's hand, the room). Ravi's silent agreement is carried by his smile and posture. The PLAN OF CARE label is clearly below the balloon and works as a screen label. Nothing blocks reading.
